seriesTitle: World War II: From the Frontlines

episodes.title: The Master Race
episodes.summary: 1939–1940. Germany has already invaded Austria and Czechoslovakia. But it's only when Hitler takes Poland that the Second World War begins in earnest.

episodes.title: World Domination
episodes.summary: 1941.The war is intensifying, and the Axis powers seem unstoppable. Hitler sends troops to the Soviet border to launch Operation Barbarossa.

episodes.title: Turning Point
episodes.summary: 1942. The war has engulfed the entire world, and the Germans are winning. Until slowly, after the Battle of Stalingrad, the tide starts to turn.

episodes.title: Fortress Europe
episodes.summary: 1943. Changing tactics, the Allies venture into enemy territory. But despite heavy bombing, they struggle to gain a foothold in "Fortress Europe."

episodes.title: Invasion
episodes.summary: 1944. The Allies decide that invading Nazi-occupied Europe is their only option. On D-Day, 100,000 soldiers cross the Channel to take back France.

episodes.title: Last Stand
episodes.summary: 1945. Allied forces have reached Berlin, but Germany and Japan show no signs of giving up. The US unleash one last display of military might.
